sql.where:
p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'active' AND p.online_status = 'online'
AND (p.name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR p.sku ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR COALESCE(p.online_title, '') ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}::uuid

mapper.select:
SELECT p.id::text AS "productId", p.sku, p.name, COALESCE(p.online_title, p.name) AS "onlineTitle", p.spec, p.brand, p.unit, p.aux_unit AS "auxUnit", p.convert_rate AS "convertRate", p.sale_price AS "salePrice", p.min_order_qty AS "minOrderQty", p.step_qty AS "stepQty", p.category_id::text AS "categoryId", c.name AS "categoryName", (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_no, pi.created_at LIMIT 1) AS "imageUrl" FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.sku LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id::text AS "id", c.qty, c.created_at AS "createdAt", p.id::text AS "productId", p.sku, p.name, COALESCE(p.online_title, p.name) AS "onlineTitle", p.spec, p.unit, p.aux_unit AS "auxUnit", p.convert_rate AS "convertRate", p.sale_price AS "salePrice", p.min_order_qty AS "minOrderQty", p.step_qty AS "stepQty", p.online_status AS "onlineStatus", (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_no, pi.created_at LIMIT 1) AS "imageUrl" FROM mall_cart_item c JOIN product p ON p.id = c.product_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId}::uuid ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC

SELECT l.id::text AS "id", l.biz_type AS "bizType", l.biz_no AS "bizNo", l.amount, l.settled_amount AS "settledAmount", l.remain_amount AS "remainAmount", l.due_date AS "dueDate", l.status, CASE WHEN l.remain_amount <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.due_date IS NULL OR l.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 0 ELSE (CURRENT_DATE - l.due_date) END AS "overdueDays", l.created_at AS "createdAt" FROM ar_ledger l WHERE l.customer_id = #{customerId}::uuid AND l.status <> 'closed' ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
